items.source: Create a new InvocationFailureException with the supplied error message.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有提供的错误消息的InvocationFailureException。

items.source: Create a new InvocationFailureException with the specified error message and root cause.
items.translation: 创建一个新的InvocationFailureException，并指定错误消息和根本原因。

items.source:
Thrown when an invocation on an MBean resource failed with an exception (either
a reflection exception or an exception thrown by the target method itself).
items.translation: 当对 MBean 资源的调用因异常（无论是反射异常还是目标方法本身抛出的异常）而失败时抛出。
